summary: Notifications is an inbox panel where updates from the agent and mentions from people arrive in one list. New items drop in at the top and bump the unread count, and tabs split the list into All, Agent and Mentions. A person clicks an item to mark it read or unread, or clears everything at once with Mark all read.
use: When background agent runs finish, pause or need review while the person is elsewhere
When agent updates and teammates' mentions should share one inbox but stay easy to separate
When a header bell or side panel needs a list with a live unread count
When an agent stops at a limit and the person has to hear about it
features: Agent items show an `icon` on a tile tinted with its `color`; people's items show an `avatar` with initials.
A new id at the top of `items` drops in on its own and makes the unread count bump.
The filter switch shows all items or only those whose `kind` matches, and you can supply your own `filters`.
Clicking an item toggles `read`, and the change comes back through `onItemsChange`.
Mark all read marks every item read, and the unread dots in view clear one row after another.
An empty filter shows `emptyLabel`, which defaults to "Nothing here yet".
a11y: The unread count has an `aria-label` like "3 unread".
Each item is a button whose `aria-pressed` reports whether it has been read.
The filter is a `group` labelled Filter, and each option reports `aria-pressed`.

faq.q: How do I push a new notification in while the inbox is open?
faq.a: Control it with `items` and `onItemsChange`, and add the new item to the front of the array with an id it has not seen. It drops in at the top and the count bumps.

faq.q: Can I add my own filter, like Billing?
faq.a: Yes. Pass `filters` with a `value` and `label` for each tab, and give items the matching `kind`. The value 'all' always shows everything.

faq.q: How do I bold the subject of a notification?
faq.a: `text` takes React nodes, so wrap the subject in ``, like `<>Pricing audit finished`.
